name: NeuroAds
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: AI chat widget for Shopify trained on your catalogue, orders and policy pages that replies in the shopper's own language, with rich product cards, discount codes, order tracking and add-to-cart inside the chat. Launched June 2026 with six App Store reviews.
best_for: small and mid-size Shopify stores that want a multilingual, catalogue-aware chat widget with product cards, order tracking and add-to-cart, and want to judge it on the genuinely usable free tier of 200 conversations a month
skip_if: you need a support desk with a track record, you cannot budget against a 'conversation' nobody has defined, or routing customer names, phone numbers and addresses through a ten-week-old vendor is not a trade you want to make
honest_knock:
The app is ten weeks old. It launched on 5 June 2026 and, as of 19 August 2026, has six reviews — all five stars, all posted between 7 and 15 August, by merchants who had had it installed for five, eleven and thirteen days. Nothing about that is suspicious on its face; new apps have new reviews. But six enthusiastic first impressions from people two weeks in tell you the setup is smooth and tell you nothing about what happens when the bot gets a refund question wrong in month four. On the same page, Shopify Inbox is free with 5,488 reviews.

The listing contradicts itself on the trial. The summary at the top of the page promises a 30-day trial; the pricing table shows a 7-day free trial on all three paid plans. Assume seven days, because that is the number in the row you actually click, and check it in the charge screen before you rely on a month.

And look at what it asks for. This app requests names, email addresses, phone numbers and physical addresses of your customers, plus geolocation and IP, sixty days of order history, your discount codes and your store pages. That is a defensible list for a bot that tracks orders and offers codes, and it is also a lot of customer data to route through a ten-week-old company on the strength of six reviews. Read the privacy policy, and check where the conversations are stored, before you switch it on for a store with EU shoppers.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for 800 conversations, live human takeover and discount codes…
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-19 on apps.shopify.com/neuroads-chatbot) Four tiers, priced by conversations per month. Free: 200 conversations, AI answers about products, collections and orders, rich product cards with add-to-cart, order status and tracking in chat, replies in the shopper's language. Starter $19 a month: 800 conversations, plus live human takeover and discount codes offered in chat, 7-day free trial. Growth $49 a month or $468 a year (save 20%): 3,000 conversations, plus a revenue and ROAS dashboard, A/B testing on the chat greeting, answer insights and Klaviyo, 7-day free trial. Unlimited $119 a month or $1,142 a year (save 20%): unlimited conversations, WhatsApp and Klaviyo, advanced reporting with CSV export, chat-only discount codes, removal of the 'Powered by NeuroAds' label, a year of conversation history and dedicated onboarding, 7-day free trial. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days. Two things the pricing table does not settle. What counts as one conversation — a shopper session, a thread, a single message — is defined nowhere, and it is the only unit the whole ladder is built on. And the listing summary advertises a 30-day trial while every paid plan in the table shows seven days. Developer NEUROAD VENTURES LLC of Newport Beach, California; the app launched 5 June 2026 and has six App Store reviews.
